text: What seat count did Gideon land on for Vantorre Group in the July thread in #strategic-pod? He corrected himself in that thread and I want the corrected figure for the QBR deck.
reply_text:
The corrected figure is 280 seats for Vantorre Group. I've sent that to you in our DM.

Gideon first said 300 in the July 1 thread in #strategic-pod. At 09:19 he corrected it to 280 active seats on the production roster. The 300 had counted sandbox logins from their May rollout.

That thread is the only place I checked. It's the latest figure I found, so I can't say whether the count has changed since July 1.
